children: Astellas Pharma's cost savings and improvement in its product mix should help its earnings in the coming years, Jefferies analysts say in a note. Following strong 2Q results, the U.S. bank raises its core operating profit forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 to 710.3 billion yen, above the company's Y700 billion guidance. The bank expects the fiscal year starting April 2028 to be the trough year for Astellas after prostate cancer drug Xtandi loses exclusivity next year. Management is confident that some of its higher-margin products are growing fast enough to return Astellas to growth soon after that, the bank says. Jefferies raises its target price on Astellas to Y3,200 from Y2,800 and maintains its buy rating. Shares last closed at Y2,751.5. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
